dialogue_tut_1: Guardian, you answered the call! I am the last King still untouched by this swarm of furious blades. We call them the Iron Swarm. My life is now in your hands — or rather, in your clicks. Welcome to this endless battle.
dialogue_tut_2: Look — the guardian blades spin around me, obeying only you. Slash the enemies, don't let them get close.
dialogue_tut_3: With each wave you will gather strength, unlocking upgrades.
dialogue_tut_4: I am the Chronomancer. I control the flow of time here. When you decide — voluntarily reset your progress, and I will turn your conquered waves into diamonds. Spend them on eternal perks. The further you go, the more you get. Reset is available from wave 21.
dialogue_tut_5: If the King's health drops to zero — don't panic. I will rewind time by exactly five waves, and everything you've earned stays with you. But remember: true power lies in eternal perks, earned through voluntary reset.
dialogue_tut_6: Protect the King and don't let those blades break through. Good luck!
dialogue_wave21_1: Congratulations, you've made it through 20 waves! Now you can reset to wave 1 and earn diamonds for it! Spend them on powerful upgrades.
dialogue_end_1: I thank you for your help! The kingdom is saved thanks to you!
dialogue_end_2: The main threat has been eliminated. If you wish, you can continue playing in endless mode.
